summary: Iteration 5 full-stack verification PASS. New backend endpoints POST /api/observe and POST /api/system-map work correctly; observation chat context flows through /api/chat producing self-aware Claude replies; frontend boots with '[BOOT] indexing 21 subsystems / controls into memory...' and auto-POSTs the capability map; VoiceOutputToggle, /capabilities, /system, /speak on|off slash commands, observation interpretation overlay (data-testid=observation-interpretation) with real Claude commentary, and the dismiss control all work end-to-end. Memory drawer, neural lattice, permissions panel and prior 7 slash commands still functional (regression green). 18/18 pytest tests pass. Capability-count source-of-truth (SYSTEM_CAPABILITIES.length=21) matches everywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: VoiceOutputToggle persists in localStorage as '1'/'0' (truthy-string) — functionally correct but the review_request example assumed 'on'/'off'. Either format is fine; flagging only for awareness.

/api/system-map is POSTed twice on cold boot (React 18 StrictMode double-invokes effects in dev). Backend already idempotent (delete_many+insert_one) so behavior is correct — single row guaranteed. No fix needed in prod build, but consider a useRef guard to avoid the duplicate dev-mode network call.
ObservationScreen calls normalize() inside the inline input only. /watch slash command still feeds raw watch?v= URL (carried over from iteration 4, low priority cosmetic).
server.py is ~520 lines and still healthy. As more endpoints are added, consider splitting routers (chat.py, memory.py, observe.py, system.py).
